remarks: IN TOWN LIVING! Gracefully set on a charming in-town street, this lovely 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and convenience. Filled with natural light, this inviting home showcases timeless appeal, warm and welcoming living spaces, and the flexibility to suit today's lifestyle. The open kitchen with a comfortable sitting area with bay window serves as the heart of the home, seamlessly connecting to the formal dining room and creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The living room, centered around a wood-burning fireplace, creates a cozy and comfortable gathering space. Just beyond, a screened-in porch provides the perfect place to relax or entertain while enjoying seamless indoor-outdoor living. The lovely brick patio and spacious yard further enhance the outdoor experience, offering a beautiful backdrop for al fresco dining, play, or quiet enjoyment. The sun-filled finished third floor adds exceptional versatility, ideal for recreation, a playroom, home office, gym, or guest overflow space. Perfectly positioned in a coveted in-town location, this special home is just moments from New Canaan's vibrant village center, with easy access to shops, restaurants, parks, schools, and the train. A rare opportunity to enjoy the very best of in-town living in one of New Canaan's most desirable settings.
